overview: Ranching is a separate system from Deviants and from crop Farming: regular animals are captured live, tamed with feed (see Food & Cooking → Animal Feeds), and bred at a Youngling Hut once Tameness reaches 80-100%. Animals only produce byproducts (meat, wool, milk, hides) once Tameness is 50%+, and a territory can house a maximum of 6 ranched animals.
breedingNote: Each animal has a limited number of Breeding Chances (how many times it can produce offspring) that scale with its rarity tier — higher grades (A/S) generally get more chances and better odds at desirable offspring traits, but the exact number per tier wasn't independently re-confirmed for this database, so treat any specific figure you see elsewhere as more reliable than a number here.
